name: Sharecare
desc:
Care Advisor - Veteran Support | Est. $21/hr | Call Center Care Coordination, No Sales Expectations
Company: Sharecare (CareLinx by Sharecare)
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
CareLinx by Sharecare connects families with non-medical, in-home caregivers. In this role, you support Veterans Affairs programs, helping Veterans and their families find caregivers so they can stay safely at home. You'll guide families through searching for, interviewing, and hiring a caregiver within the care hours the VA has approved. After a match is made, you'll keep checking in with the family and caregiver to make sure everything is going well. You'll work with VA clinical and office staff, document every call, email, and text in CareLinx's records system, and meet set performance goals. It's a fast-paced call center environment where empathy and respect for Veterans matter.

Soft Skills
- Empathy and respect for Veterans and families
- Relationship building
- Organization and multitasking
- Clear communication by phone, email, and text
- Problem solving
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: At least 1 year in a productivity-based customer service role or call center, or at least 2 years in a customer service environment
Preferred Experience: Some college coursework, healthcare experience, and military experience (a plus, not required)

Required Skills:
- Good time management and attention to detail
- Excellent verbal and written communication
- Strong organization and multitasking
- Goal-driven problem solver
- Professional, confident, outgoing manner
- Microsoft Office
- Keeps information confidential and uses good judgment

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Is a Veteran, military spouse, or family member who wants to serve those who served
- Has a year of call center or 2 years of customer service experience
- Enjoys building ongoing relationships with families
- Has healthcare or caregiving experience

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has less than 1 year of call center or 2 years of customer service experience
- Doesn't like working toward performance goals
- Struggles to keep detailed notes on every call
- Prefers quick one-time calls over ongoing follow-up
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Care coordination
- Call center
- Veteran support
- Caregiver matching
- Customer relationship management
- EHR documentation
- Performance goals
- Phone, email, and text support
- Confidentiality
- Military or Veteran experience

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your call center or customer service experience.
- Why do you want to support Veterans and their families?
- A family is unhappy with their caregiver. How would you handle it?
- Tell us about a time you built a strong relationship with a customer over time. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you met a tough goal at work. What was the goal, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: Est. $19 to $24/hr, working estimate $21/hr. Pay isn't listed in the posting. A job board listing for CareLinx's Care Advisor role estimated $40,000 to $50,000 a year, which is about $19.23 to $24.04/hr. Full-time, hourly.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage. (An earlier Sharecare posting listed any 8-hour shift Monday through Friday between 7:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m. Central, plus one Saturday every 4 to 6 weeks, so ask if that applies.)
-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is meaningful work helping Veterans stay in their homes, and Veterans and military families are strongly encouraged to apply, though military experience isn't required. It's a good fit for participants with call center or customer service experience. Sharecare uses E-Verify. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Care Advisor → Senior Care Advisor → Care Advisor Team Lead → Care Operations Supervisor. This role builds care coordination, healthcare customer service, and Veteran program skills.
